title: Micro-investing for teens
summary: Teach teenagers to invest with small amounts.
whyTempting: Parents want financially literate kids; long customer lifetime.
whyItFails: Low balances. Tiny accounts make revenue negligible. Regulatory burden. Minors, custody and licensing add cost. Kids churn to adult platforms. Lifetime value doesn't materialise.
whatWouldChange: Bank partnerships that absorb compliance and value the customer acquisition.

attempts.outcome: Discontinued its banking and debit products
attempts.notes: Hit by the collapse of its banking-as-a-service partner, Synapse.

attempts.outcome: Winding down; kids' accounts moved to Stash
attempts.notes: Gift-card style investing for kids and teens.
